title: 第474章 入熔岩踏玄冰第473章 突生变故
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
轰！
这名青年跳入的刹那，仿佛为冰火神湖的底下添加了一把火，岩浆表面竟熊熊燃起了一层赤红的火焰。
呼！
天地间蓦然刮起一阵风，火焰愈发旺盛，岩浆愈加沸腾！
“不行，还得再退几步！”
一些修为较低的生灵通体被那股高温炙烤得通红，带着恐惧之色再度退了几步。
沸腾的岩浆中。
那青年脸色凝重，身躯微微有些颤抖，他深呼吸一口气，目光愈发坚定，开始向着湖中心游去。
一丈，两丈，十丈，百丈......
片刻时间过去，在岸上众人的目光中，那青年已然行进了一百多丈的距离。
可他的速度越来越慢，也愈发颤抖的厉害，仿佛在承受着莫大的压力。
他的身躯愈发通红无比，甚至隐隐有火焰在其体表燃烧起来。
不久后，距离岸边两百丈之处。
那青年停了下来，他身躯剧烈抖动，使得附近岩浆荡开一层又一层涟漪。
他似乎已经到了极限状态，久久没有前进，眉头紧皱，脸上写满了痛苦，眼中更是不断有挣扎之意闪过。
他在犹豫，到底是继续向前，还是从此退去。
肉身被烧得通红，全身血液沸腾无比，一身血肉仿佛下一刻就会融化！
“啊......”
最终，青年发出带着一丝不甘与痛苦的悲吼，从原地开始游回岸边。
岸边，许多人静静地看着青年，但思绪却已经纷飞，脸色不是特别好看。

两百丈！
听起来是一个很不错的数字。
可这连整个岩浆界域都没有穿过，最多三分之一！
“王师兄，快上来！”
岸边有几名男女神色担忧又焦急，他们口中的王师兄正是那青年，名为王钧。
“王师兄，你没事吧......快服下这株灵药......”
几人连忙把王钧搀扶到不远处的一棵树下，当看其脸色有些好转之后，几人眼中的担忧散去了许多。
“呼呼......多谢诸位师弟师妹......”王钧缓了一口气。
“王师兄，这湖里的岩浆也太可怕了，以你的实力，居然也不能完全穿过去。”看着王钧身上各处的灼伤，惨烈无比，一名少女心有余悸地说道。
“是啊，王师兄可是逍遥境七重天的境界，连他都无法.......”
“哼！一个肉身孱弱的人族，岂能和我等相提并论！”
这时，一道高傲的声音忽然响起，一名身材高大、散发着浓浓的妖族气息的男子露出了讥讽的笑容。
“你说什么......”
王钧循着声音望去，怒目而视，但声音戛然而止！
妖族男子头生两只乌黑牛角，身材异常高大，古铜色皮肤宛如精铁浇筑，浑身肌肉虬结，高高隆起，气势厚重，仿佛一座不可逾越的高山！
更可怕的是，此人散发的气息更是比王钧强横一倍不止！
“黑铁镇岳牛一族！”许多人认出了此人的身份。
王钧与几位师弟师妹瞬间噤声，敢怒不敢言。
别说他此刻受了伤，就是没受伤，以他初入逍遥境七重天的境界也打不过这妖族男子。
“呵！”

铁擎岳见状，嗤笑一声，神色极其高傲！
content_en:
boom!
The moment this young man jumped in, it was as if a fire was added to the bottom of the Ice and Fire God Lake, and a layer of red flames ignited on the surface of the magma.
call!
A gust of wind suddenly blew between heaven and earth, the flames became more intense, and the magma became more boiling!
"No, we have to take a few more steps back!"
Some creatures with lower cultivation levels were burned red by the high temperature, and they took a few steps back with fear.
In boiling magma.
The young man's face was solemn and his body was trembling slightly. He took a deep breath, his eyes became firmer, and he began to swim towards the center of the lake.
One foot, two feet, ten feet, one hundred feet...
A moment passed, and in the eyes of everyone on the shore, the young man had traveled a distance of more than a hundred feet.
But his speed was getting slower and slower, and he was shaking more and more violently, as if he was under great pressure.
His body became increasingly red, and there was even a faint flame burning on his surface.
Not long after, we were two hundred feet away from the shore.
The young man stopped, and his body shook violently, causing ripples to form in the nearby magma.
He seemed to have reached his limit. He did not move forward for a long time, his brows were furrowed, his face was full of pain, and there was a constant flash of struggle in his eyes.
He was hesitating whether to continue moving forward or to retreat.
The flesh was burned red, the blood in the whole body was boiling, and the flesh and blood seemed to melt in the next moment!
"Ah..."
Finally, the young man roared with a trace of unwillingness and pain, and started to swim back to the shore from where he was.
On the shore, many people looked at the young man quietly, but their thoughts were already racing, and their faces were not particularly good-looking.
Two hundred feet!
Sounds like a pretty good number.
But this doesn't even pass through the entire magma realm, at most one third!
"Senior Brother Wang, come up quickly!"
There were several men and women on the shore who looked worried and anxious. The senior brother they were talking about was the young man named Wang Jun.
"Senior Brother Wang, are you okay...take this elixir quickly..."
Several people quickly helped Wang Jun to a tree not far away. After seeing that his face improved a little, the worries in their eyes dissipated a lot.
"Huhu... Thank you all junior brothers and sisters..." Wang Jun breathed a sigh of relief.
"Senior Brother Wang, the magma in this lake is too terrifying. Even with your strength, you can't completely pass through it." Looking at the extremely tragic burns all over Wang Jun's body, a girl said with lingering fear.
"Yes, Senior Brother Wang is at the seventh level of Xiaoyao Realm, and even he can't..."
"Hmph! How can a human race with a weak body be compared with us!"
At this time, a proud voice suddenly sounded, and a tall man exuding a strong demonic aura showed a sarcastic smile.
"What did you say..."
Wang Jun followed the sound and looked angrily, but the sound stopped suddenly!
The demon man had two jet-black horns and was unusually tall. His bronze skin looked like it was made of fine iron. His muscles were all tangled and bulging high, and he was as imposing as an insurmountable mountain!
What's even more frightening is that the aura exuded by this person is more than twice as powerful as Wang Jun!
"Black Iron Town Yueniu Clan!" Many people recognized this person's identity.
Wang Jun and several junior brothers and sisters immediately fell silent. They dared not speak out if they dared to be angry.
Not to mention that he was injured at the moment, even if he was not injured, he could not defeat this demon man even if he had just entered the seventh heaven of Xiaoyao Realm.
"Ha!"
When Tie Qingyue saw this, he sneered and looked extremely arrogant!
